title: BlueLinx Accelerates Outdoor Living Expansion with Fiberon® Decking in 34 Locations and Railing in 15 Locations
summary: ATLANTA, October 28, 2026--BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, today announced that it is expanding Fiberon® decking to 31 additional BlueLinx distribution centers in key U.S. markets, bringing the company’s total Fiberon decking footprint to 34 locations. BlueLinx will also stock Fiberon railing in 15 locations, expanding its commitment to Fiberon’s high-performance Outdoor Living product portfolio.
